Extract SimPO loss equation text snippets from paper.pdf: $ python - <<'PY' from pypdf import PdfReader import re path='/root/SimPO/paper.pdf' reader=PdfReader(path) print('pages', len(reader.pages)) pat=re.compile(r"(SimPO|loss|\u03b2|beta|\u03b3|gamma)", re.IGNORECASE) for i,p in enumerate(reader.pages):     text=p.extract_text() or ''     if pat.search(text):         # show a compact snippet around occurrences         lines=[ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if pat.search(ln)]         if lines:             print('\n--- page', i+1, '---')             for ln in lines[:30]:                 print(ln) PY
